name: Chief Noble
source: The Chief of the Bureau, a former agent rumored to have been chosen by the Selenon, he is privy to the most secret information. He is insistent that the New Moon Resistance be wiped out before humanity itself is destroyed in retribution. His take-no-prisoners personality can be grating to some, but no one dares contest his decisions.
